description: Which models did, or are doing, an issue's work: each use with its 'model' (one id — 'opus-5.5' and 'claude-opus-5-5' are one), 'written' (as it was reported), 'name', 'vendor', 'via' (a router such as openmath, apart from the vendor), 'role' (plan, code, review…), 'source' — run (an agent run reported with report_agent_usage, bgs's included), agent (the tracker's own agents; 'built-in' is the tracker's own AI, named no further) or manual (set_issue_models) — 'agent', the dates and 'now' (begun and not ended). 'summary' gathers them by model. get_issue carries the summary as 'models'. Search: JQL model = "claude-opus-5-5" (or a vendor, or a router).
name: get_issue_models
title: Get issue models
